summary: Define product metrics, event instrumentation, funnels, cohorts, and experiments.
intents: define the north-star metric for our app
design the event tracking plan for signup
build a funnel from these events
analyze retention cohorts by signup month
did the new feature improve activation
prerequisites: product goals, user journeys, and the decision the analysis should inform
available event data, analytics schema, or an instrumentation environment
privacy, consent, retention, and data access requirements where applicable
verify: Each metric has a precise definition, owner and data source
Event names and properties follow one documented schema
Experiment results report confidence intervals, not only p-values
